_what: How read-data/demonstration.mjs (tool:record-a-demonstration) turns a short, bounded recording of what the person does on this Mac into a draft workflow for save_workflow. The recording is made by do-work/demonstration-recorder.swift (listen only; needs Input Monitoring, and Accessibility to name what was clicked). Typed text in a secure field is never recorded. The gates are the person's grant of the row's capability to this tool and the Mac's own Input Monitoring permission. Every word of a step is a template here.

steps.secret: In {app}, type the secret the person supplies (it was not recorded).

draft.label: A job shown once
draft.job: Repeat the job the person showed on this Mac, step by step

done.description: What was done in this step

words.needs_input_monitoring: This Mac has not given Input Monitoring to the program that records. The person turns it on in System Settings > Privacy & Security; this is a Mac permission, separate from the person's yes in Trillion.
words.nothing: Nothing was recorded in that time. Ask the person to show the job again.

ended.stop_key: The person pressed the stop key.
ended.most_events: The recording reached its most events.
